Kai M: Putting a tiny, paste-friendly go-live checklist for CS + AE handoffs. One-screen only.
Lina S: Please include a streaming quick-verify that PMs can run.
Devon R: Also add the renewal-watch tags we auto-apply so AEs get notified.
Kai M: Compact runbook (copy/paste):
- Prefill top 25 prompts to hydrate KV & embeddings.
- Reserve warm pool = max(2, ceil(estimated_concurrency * 0.45)).
- Prime prefix cache for long prompts.
- Run two streaming checks: full stream + truncated chunk.
- Enable transient fallback to smaller model for non-critical paths.
- Monitor first-72h signals and auto-tag renewal-risk when triggered.

Kai M: Prefill (curl, ops):
```bash
curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.example/v1/prefill" \  
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \  
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \  
  -d '{"tenant":"startup_inc","prompts":["welcome","get_started","help"],"limit":25}'
```
Lina S: Streaming quick-verify (curl SSE) for PMs:
```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \  
  -d '{"input":"hello","max_tokens":48}' \  
  "https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream?model=redwood-mini"
```
Devon R: Retry guidance for front-end: exponential backoff + full jitter, retries=3, base_ms=200, cap_ms=20000. If cumulative latency > 25s, surface to async queue.
Kai M: Auto-tag renewal-risk triggers (auto rules for AE): sustained 5xx > 2% over baseline for 30m; >=15% drop in completion rate; repeated 429 spikes in first 72h; go-live survey <=3. Tag `cs:renewal-risk` and schedule a 15-min AE check.
Devon R: Monitoring snippet (pseudo-yaml) for AEs/SRE to copy: `alert: TenantStreamIssues when increase(stream_chunk_misses_total{tenant="startup_inc"}[15m]) > 5 for 10m`
ops-bot: prefill job started for tenant startup_inc  job id pf-321  ETA ~90s.
alerts-bot: Alert rule TenantStreamIssues created and linked to AE rota.
Kai M: TL;DR for AE paste: prefill -> reserve warm pool -> run stream smoke -> enable retries -> watch alerts -> capture feedback -> tag & engage. I'll make a one-pager tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
